title: Deeper/broader downstream app routes and vendored DWG codec lineage
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Screen newly surfaced open-source CAD applications for DWG/DXF parser and writer lineage
Distinguish a downstream consumer using a patched vendored codec from an independent parser or an upstream test run
Reconcile current CADCraft DWG claims with its dated file-format gap inventory
Update the plan without adding required gates, fixtures, dependencies, findings, or support claims

method.kind: Read official project repositories, README, build integration, and gap documentation
method.limitations: Mutable project pages were reviewed on 2026-10-18; exact source commits and binaries were not captured or executed. CADCraft's gap inventory is dated and self-reported. GoSurvey's CMake comments identify a modified vendored LibreDWG tree, but its full patch was not audited. No behavioral or semantic support conclusion is inferred.

sources.observed: The project describes a Windows survey CAD application with DWG/DXF exchange and states GPL-3.0-or-later licensing because of LibreDWG linkage.
The build compiles a local static copy identified as upstream LibreDWG tag 0.14 plus GoSurvey changes, and states that upstream's own CMake probes, programs, and tests are not used.
The README advertises DWG R13-R2018 read/write through the ACadRust library.

sources.revision: Mutable main page; document says reviewed 2026-10-10 and updated 2026-10-11
sources.observed: The dated self-report lists unknown-content preservation, real-file corpus, and AutoCAD acceptance as alpha blockers; it reports 36 synthetic file tests and no AutoCAD verification at that review date.
The project remains explicitly pre-alpha, separates container/object parsing from incomplete entity decoders, and describes experimental writers without external CAD acceptance.
The project documents a narrow modern-version native 2D decode profile, an AC1015 subset writer, and ezdxf-backed DXF export.

assessment.planImpact: Classify GoSurvey as an optional patched-LibreDWG-derived consumer and CADCraft as an ACadRust-lineage application with dated self-reported qualification gaps. Neither is an independent parser or semantic-solid oracle; do not add mandatory execution or change the implementation/validation queue.

workingTree.reason: Only the parity plan and this research receipt were changed. The shared worktree has extensive existing local changes; no other files were touched.
